text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer! Thanks to you, I got to rest 
my wings properly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
After soaking thoroughly in a piping-hot 
bath, you take a bottle of ice-cold fruit 
milk and... chug it down! When you do 
that—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Pure bliiiss♪ Pure bliiiss♪ An o~asis in 
the shopping district~♪ ...Or somethin' 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, that bathhouse was just as good as 
the ads said. Next time, let's go 
together, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, that bathhouse was just as good as 
the ads said. Next time, let's go 
together, Big Sis!
